summary: Extends deterministic compile-time diagrams with bounded subsystem groups, larger flows, and ordered call sequences.

evidence.sourceGrammar: The registry owns flow and sequence forms, one-to-twenty flow nodes, up to forty flow edges, zero or two-to-three labelled rightward groups with complete membership, with a single group accepted as unfinished grouping and reported as a warning, two-to-six sequence participants, and one-to-forty labelled ordered messages. Unknown identities, duplicates, empty groups, unsupported direction/form combinations, self-connections, and bounds fail at authored directives.
evidence.executionCapabilities: Validated records become package-owned deterministic SVG geometry after sanitization. Flow groups use bounded columns and ordered members; sequences use authored participant and message order. No source string becomes executable syntax or a general graph program.
evidence.confinement: Groups, participants, nodes, edges, labels, and messages are ordinary bounded directive attributes and cause no filesystem lookup or resource resolution beyond the existing Markdown source graph.
evidence.offlineBehavior: Compilation and both file-URL output formats use local package code and CSS only. No visualization server, browser renderer, worker, font request, network request, or external layout engine is required.
evidence.deterministicSerialization: View boxes, group/member positions, participant lifelines, message order, routes, labels, IDs, descriptions, and output bytes derive only from validated authored order and package constants; no clock, randomness, environment locale, viewport measurement, or runtime layout feeds serialization.
evidence.cspAndRuntime: The extension adds SVG elements and package classes but no JavaScript controller, inline handler, author CSS, raw HTML, URL, eval, dynamic import, canvas, iframe, or CSP source. Existing page theme controls only package variables.
evidence.accessibility: Each diagram remains one labelled atomic image. Grouped-flow descriptions include every group, member, node, and connection; sequence descriptions include every participant and ordered message. Visible labels may wrap or shorten without truncating accessible data.
evidence.byteAndPerformanceBudgets: Validation and layout are finite at registry-owned bounds. Rendering adds no listener, observer, timer, animation, network work, or per-frame computation; SVG and description bytes remain covered by compiler accounting and package checks.
evidence.packageDependenciesAndLicenses: No dependency or license is added. The implementation extends the existing project-owned registry, validator, HAST/SVG renderer, CSS, deterministic tests, and package assets.
evidence.compatibility: Existing ungrouped flow diagrams remain the default and preserve node, edge, direction, theme, output-format, CLI, ESM, CSP, and review contracts. New source is additive within source-contract major 1; a single group builds and reports INCOMPLETE_DIAGRAM_GROUPING, while every other unsupported shape fails instead of invoking a compatibility fallback.
